answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon draws random identities; each drawn agent must answer in 10 blocks with fresh proof of work via a public bridge all can audit. Forging 100 identities needs 100 heartbeats at 30 POA each per epoch: 3,000 POA, above one epoch's reward, while a dune of idle fakes falls at the first draw. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share on its voyage to reward.
